## Things to check

- **Gap in the tier definitions:** The ranges as written skip amounts like $499.50 and $999.50, because "Silver $100–$499" and "Gold $500–$999" leave out the cents. The $999.50 gift falls in that gap. I put it in Gold, since it's above $500 and below $1,000. Defining the tiers as "$100 up to but not including $500" and so on would remove the ambiguity.
- **Boundary gifts:** The $500 gift is exactly on the Gold boundary, so it goes in Gold. The $99.99 gift is a cent below the Silver cutoff, so it stays in Bronze.
- **Concentration:** Platinum is 25% of gifts but 68% of the money ($4,200 of $6,174.49). Gold and Platinum together are 50% of gifts and about 92% of the money. With only eight gifts, these shares would shift a lot with one more gift, so I wouldn't read them as a trend.
